sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: I hymn Thee, having heard, O Lord, Thy
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: I hymn Thee, having heard, O Lord, Thy report... to understand the mystical ranks: even as the bodiless Angels cry unto Thee with fear, O unoriginate Trinity: so we also with clay tongues cry unto Thee: Creator of creation...

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Просвѣще́ніе въ тмѣ́ лежа́щій: я́кѡ вели́чіи
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: просвещение в тме лежащий яко величии
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ φωτισμὸς τῶν ἐν σκότει κειμένων
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Enlightenment of those lying in darkness: as the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Enlightenment of those lying in darkness: as the greatness of Thy providence over all things, extending rays of salvation unto me, O King of peace: preserve us in Thy faith, for Thou art the Life and Peace of all!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Въ бе́зднѣ грѣхо́внѣй ѡ҆держи́мъ, сотвори́телю мл҃ти
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: в бездне греховней одержим сотворителю млти
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἐν ἀβύσσῳ πταισμάτων κυκλούμενος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Held fast in the abyss of sin, O
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Held fast in the abyss of sin, O Creator of mercy, have mercy: Thou Who art the calm of the faithful, O God of three suns: save us from innumerable transgressions and from passions!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ѡ҆ тѣ́лѣ зла́тѣ на по́ли Деи́рѣ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: о теле злате на поли деире
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἀντίθεον πρόσταγμα παρανόμου τυράννου
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Concerning the golden image on the plain of
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Concerning the golden image on the plain of Dura: The Prophets establish that the angelic Godhead is unchanging, O Lord Who alone art immutable and in three Persons: show my heart also ever unchanging, that I may fervently glorify Thee and piously hymn Thee!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: В подо́біи зла́тѣ неразроши́: Присносꙋ́щнаа Тр(ои)це
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: в подобии злате неразроши присносущнаа тр ои це
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Κάμινος ποτὲ πυρὸς ἐν Βαβυλῶνι
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: In the likeness of gold: O ever-existing Trinity
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: In the likeness of gold: O ever-existing Trinity, co-eternal, unoriginate, sole ruler, unchanging unto ages: apart from Thy light-bearers, destroy all the evil assaults of adversaries and disturbances among men; keep Thy servants unharmed ever, O Lord of all!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Безначална родитела
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: безначална родитела
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ τῷ Πατρὶ συνάναρχος Υἱὸς καὶ Λόγος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The Lord, Who is co-unoriginate with the Father
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The Lord, Who is co-unoriginate with the Father, having become incarnate from the Virgin, hath appeared unto us: to enlighten the darkened, and to gather together the dispersed; therefore the all-hymned Theotokos do we magnify.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Иже воды древле, маніемъ Божественымъ, въ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: иже води древле манием божественим в
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ τὰ ὕδατα πάλαι νεύματι θείῳ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: He Who of old by His divine nod
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: He Who of old by His divine nod gathered the waters into one gathering, and divided the sea for the people of Israel: this is our God, and He is exceedingly glorious; unto Him alone let us sing, for He hath been glorified.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: И́же ѿ неси́щныхъ вся̀ приве́: трои́ти
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: иже от несищних вся приве троити
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ ἐκ μὴ ὄντων τὰ πάντα παραγαγών
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: He Who brought all things out of nothing
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: He Who brought all things out of nothing: to divide the waters of old, He commanded, watering the earth; prefiguring unto all the Trinitarian hypostasis of the sole Godhead and Dominion.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Положи́ кна́ тве́рдꙋю любо́вь: Ѻц҃ъ оу́бо
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: положи кна твердую любов оц оубо
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἔθου πρὸς ἡμᾶς κραταιὰν ἀγάπην, Κύριε
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Thou hast set firm love toward us: the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Thou hast set firm love toward us: the Father indeed toward Thee, O Father, as a shoot from the root, the Son and the right Spirit, natural shoots and God-planted flowers without beginning, so as to be luminaries of the Godhead in spiritual essences; unceasingly they hymn Thee, the unfathomable God, with whom we also glorify, saying: 'O transcendent Trinity, preserve Thy servants, as Thou art merciful!'

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ктебѣ оутренюю везжественныхъ Ангеловъ, преимущемъ всякъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: ктебе оутренюю везжественних ангелов преимущем всяк
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Πρὸς σὲ ὀρθρίζω, τὸν πάντων Δημιουργόν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Unto Thee do I rise early in the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Unto Thee do I rise early in the morning, surpassing all immaterial angelic mind, a small world; for Thy commandments are light: wherein guide Thou me.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Иже въ конецъ вѣкѡмъ дошедшихъ члѣколюбче
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: иже в конец веком дошедших члеколюбче
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἄβυσσος ἐσχάτη ἁμαρτημάτων ἐκύκλωσέ με
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Thou Who hast reached unto the end of
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Thou Who hast reached unto the end of the ages, O Lover of mankind, and hast them that are engulfed in the storm-tossed thoughts of wrath: despise not them that cry: Save, O Savior, as Thou didst save the Prophet from the beast.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Якоже древле, блгочестивыя три отроки ѡросилъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: якоже древле блгочестивия три отроки оросил
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὡς πάλαι τοὺς εὐσεβεῖς τρεῖς Παῖδας
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: As of old Thou didst bedew the three
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: As of old Thou didst bedew the three pious Children in the Chaldean furnace: with the bright fire of the Godhead enlighten us also, who cry: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Въ непостоянномъ огни сококубльшеся, иже блгочестіемъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: в непостоянном огни сококубльшеся иже блгочестием
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἀστέκτῳ πυρὶ ἑνωθέντες
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Gathered together in the unenduring fire, yet unharmed
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Gathered together in the unenduring fire, yet unharmed by the flame, the youths pre-eminent in piety sang a divine hymn: 'Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord; sing and exalt Him above all unto the ages!'

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Новое чюдо, и бголѣпное: Дѣвическою оубо
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: новое чюдо и бголепное девическою оубо
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Καινὸν τὸ θαῦμα καὶ θεοπρεπές
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: A new wonder and God-befitting: for through the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: A new wonder and God-befitting: for through the closed virginal gate the Lord manifestly passes; bare at His entrance, and flesh-bearing God appeared at His going forth, and the gate remains shut: her unceasingly as Mother of God do we magnify.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Триста́ты крѣ́пкїѧ, рожде́нся ѡ Дв҃ы, безстра́стїя
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: тристати крепкия рожденся о дви безстрастия
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Θαλάσσης τὸ ἐρυθραῖον πέλαγος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The three mighty captains: He Who was born
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The three mighty captains: He Who was born of the Virgin hath drowned the tripartite soul in the deep of impassibility; by prayer, as upon a timbrel, in the mortification of the body, let me sing a hymn of victory unto Thee!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: С высоты̀ сни́де во́лею на́землю, и́же
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: с висоти сниде волею наземлю иже
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Εὐφραίνεται ἐπὶ σοὶ ἡ Ἐκκλησία σου, Χριστέ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: From on high He descended willingly upon the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: From on high He descended willingly upon the earth, He Who is exalted above every principality and power, and hath lifted up from nethermost hades the humble nature of mankind; for there is none holy save Thee, O Lord!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Воздви́жена тя̀ видѣ́вши Це́рковь на Кр́тѣ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: воздвижена тя видевши церков на крте
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἐπαρθέντα σε ἰδοῦσα ἡ Ἐκκλησία
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Beholding Thee, the Sun of righteousness, lifted up upon the Cross, the Church stood in her station, worthily crying aloud: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Нн҃ѣ воста́нꙋ, прр́чески речѐ, Бг҃: нн҃ѣ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: нне востану пррчески рече бг нне
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Σύ, Κύριέ μου, φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθας
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Now will I arise," prophetically saith God; "now
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Now will I arise," prophetically saith God; "now will I be glorified; now will I be exalted, taking up him who fell from the Virgin, and I will lift him up unto the marvelous light of My Godhead.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Прїидо́хъ во глубинꙋ морскꙋю, и потопѝ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: приидох во глубину морскую и потопи
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Θύσω σοι μετὰ φωνῆς αἰνέσεως, Κύριε
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: I came into the deep of the sea
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: I came into the deep of the sea, and the tempest of many transgressions overwhelmed me; but as God, lead up my life from corruption, O Plenteous in mercy!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Въ пе́щи ѻ́гненнѣй авраа́мстіи ѻ́троци перси́дстеи
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: в пещи огненней авраамстии отроци персидстеи
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ Ἀβραμιαῖοι Παῖδες
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: In the fiery furnace the Persian children of
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: In the fiery furnace the Persian children of Abraham, burned rather by the desire of piety than by the flame, cried aloud: Blessed art Thou in the temple of Thy glory, O Lord!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Изба́вителю всѣ́хъ всеси́лне, посредѣ̀ пла́мене бл҃гоче́ствова́вшаѧ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: избавителю всех всесилне посреде пламене блгочествовавшая
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Χεῖρας ἐκπετάσας Δανιήλ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: O Almighty Deliverer of all: descending into the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: O Almighty Deliverer of all: descending into the midst of the flame, Thou didst bedew the pious ones, and didst teach them to sing: "Bless the Lord, all ye works of the Lord, sing and exalt Him unto all ages!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Еѵ́ва ѹ́бо недꙋ́го преслꙋша́нїа, кля́твꙋ всели́ла
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: еива ѹбо недуго преслушаниа клятву вселила
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Λίθος ἀχειρότμητος ὄρους
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Eve indeed, through the disease of disobedience, brought
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Eve indeed, through the disease of disobedience, brought in the curse; but Thou, O Virgin Theotokos, through the blossoming of Thy childbearing, didst bud forth blessing unto the world. Therefore we all magnify Thee.

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Коня̀ и҆ вса́дника въ мо́ре чермно́е
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: коня и всадника в море чермное
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἵππον καὶ ἀναβάτην εἰς θάλασσαν Ἐρυθράν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The steed and rider into the Red Sea
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The steed and rider into the Red Sea: Christ Who shatters warfare with a high arm shook them off; but He saved Israel, as they sang a song of victory!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Оу҆тверзе́й ниначїо́мъ же: зми́сленъ ѹ҆мная сꙋще́ства
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: оутверзей ниначиом же змислен ѹмная существа
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ πήξας ἐπ' οὐδενὸς τὴν γῆν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Thou Who upon nothing didst establish the noetic
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Thou Who upon nothing didst establish the noetic essences by Thy thought, and didst constitute them as unceasing chanters of Thy Godhead, O Tri-radiant God and Creator of all: receive also from mortals and earthborn beings praise and supplication, as Thou art tender-hearted!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Бж҃твенное твоѐ разꙋмѣ́въ истоща́нїе, прозри́тельнѣ А҆вваку́мъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: бжтвенное твое разумев истощание прозрительне аввакум
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Τὴν θείαν ἐννοήσας σου κένωσιν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Perceiving Thy divine condescension with prophetic insight, O
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Perceiving Thy divine condescension with prophetic insight, O Christ, Habakkuk cried aloud unto Thee in trembling: Thou art come for the salvation of Thy people, to save Thine anointed ones!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ѡ҆дѣѧ́исѧ свѣ́томъ, ꙗ́кѡ ри́зою, к тебѣ̀
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: одеяися светом ꙗко ризою к тебе
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ ἀναβαλλόμενος φῶς ὡς ἱμάτιον
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Thou Who clothest Thyself with light as with a garment, unto Thee I rise early and unto Thee I cry: Enlighten my darkened soul, O Christ, as the only Merciful One!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Волноꙋ́щееся бꙋ́рею дꙋшетлѣ́н
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: волноущееся бурею душетлен
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Μαινομένην κλύδωνι ψυχοφθόρων παθῶν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Surging with the storm of soul-corrupting passions, O
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Surging with the storm of soul-corrupting passions, O Master Christ, calm the tempestuous sea, and lead me up from corruption, as Thou art compassionate!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Превозноси́мый Ѻ҆тце́мъ Гдⷭ҇ь
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: превозносимий отцем гд
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ ὑπερυψούμενος τῶν Πατέρων Κύριος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The Lord God of our fathers, praised above
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The Lord God of our fathers, praised above all, extinguished the flame and bedewed the youths who sang with one accord: Blessed art Thou, O God!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Тебѐ Вседѣ́телю въ пе́щи ѿроцы, всемї́рный
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: тебе вседетелю в пещи отроци всемирний
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Σοὶ τῷ παντουργῷ ἐν τῇ καμίνῳ Παῖδες
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the youth
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Unto Thee, the Creator of all, the youth in the furnace, forming a universal choir, sang: All ye works of the Lord, sing praise unto the Lord, and exalt Him above all forever!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: И҆са́їа ликꙋ́й, Дв҃аа бо прїѧ́тъ въ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: исаиа ликуй дваа бо прият в
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἠσαΐα χόρευε, ἡ Παρθένος ἔσχεν ἐν γαστρί
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Rejoice, O Isaiah! For a Virgin hath conceived
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Rejoice, O Isaiah! For a Virgin hath conceived in her womb and borne a Son, Emmanuel, God and Man; the Dayspring is His name; Whom magnifying, we call Thee blessed, O Virgin!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ꙗ҆́кωтве́нный Фараѡ́нъ, погло́пленъ бы́сть со во́инствомъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: ꙗкωтвенний фараон поглоплен бист со воинством
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὡς ἐν ἠπείρῳ πεζεύσας ὁ Ἰσραήλ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The hard-hearted Pharaoh was swallowed up with his
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The hard-hearted Pharaoh was swallowed up with his army, but Israel passed through the midst of the sea, crying aloud: "Let us sing unto the Lord our God, for He hath been glorified!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Нѣ́сть ст҃ъ ꙗ҆́коже ты̀, Гдⷭ҇и Бж҃е
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: нест ст ꙗкоже ти гди бже
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Οὐκ ἔστιν ἅγιος ὡς σύ, Κύριε ὁ Θεός μου
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: There is none holy as Thou, O Lord
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: There is none holy as Thou, O Lord my God, Who hast exalted the horn of Thy faithful, O Good One, and established us upon the rock of Thy confession!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Хрⷭ҇то́съ моѧ̀ си́ла, Бг҃ъ и҆ Гдⷭ҇ь
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: хртос моя сила бг и гд
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Χριστός μου δύναμις, Θεὸς καὶ Κύριος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Christ is my power, God and Lord!" the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Christ is my power, God and Lord!" the venerable Church divinely cries aloud, keeping feast in the Lord from a pure understanding!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Бж҃твеннымъ свѣ́то́ ти Бл҃же: ᲂу҆́тренюющихъ тебѣ̀
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: бжтвенним свето ти блже ᲂутренюющих тебе
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Τῷ θείῳ φέγγει σου, ἀγαθέ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: With Thy Divine light, O Good One, illumine
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: With Thy Divine light, O Good One, illumine, I pray Thee, the souls of those who rise early unto Thee with love, to behold Thee, O Word of God, the true God, Who deliverest us from the gloom of sins!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Къ то́мꙋ поже́ртꙋ бы́въ грѣхо́внымъ: вопїю́
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: к тому пожерту бив греховним вопию
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Τοῦ βίου τὴν θάλασσαν ὑψουμένην καθορῶν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Being swallowed up by the abyss of sins
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Being swallowed up by the abyss of sins, I cry unto Thee, O Christ, with the Prophet: Lead me up from corruption!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Хладода́тельнꙋ ᲂу҆́бо пе́щь, сотвори́ А҆́гг҃лъ прпⷣбнымъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: хладодательну ᲂубо пещ сотвори аггл прпбним
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Δροσοβόλον μὲν τὴν κάμινον
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The Angel made the furnace sprinkle dew for
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The Angel made the furnace sprinkle dew for the holy children, but the command of God consumed the Chaldeans, persuading the tyrant to cry: "Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: И҆з̾пла́мене ст҃ы̑мъ, ро́сꙋ и҆сточи́: и҆ пра́днаго
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: изпламене стим росу источи и праднаго
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἐκ φλογὸς τοῖς ὁσίοις δρόσον ἐπήγασας
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: From the flame Thou didst pour forth dew for the holy youths, and with water didst burn up the sacrifice of the righteous man; for Thou dost all things, O Christ, whatsoever Thou desirest: Whom we supremely exalt unto all ages!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Бг҃а чл҃кѡмъ невозмо́жно ви́дѣти, на́ньже несмѣ́ютъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: бга члком невозможно видети наньже несмеют
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Θεὸν ἀνθρώποις ἰδεῖν ἀδύνατον
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: It is impossible for men to see God
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: It is impossible for men to see God, upon Whom the ranks of Angels dare not gaze; but through Thee, O most pure one, the Word incarnate was revealed unto us: Whom magnifying, together with the heavenly hosts we magnify Thee!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ма́нїемъ тѝ на зе́млемъ ѡ҆бразꙋ́етсѧ мно́готꙋлъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: манием ти на землем образуется многотул
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Νεύματί σου πρὸς γεώδη ἀντίτυπον
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: By Thy nod upon earth is fashioned the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: By Thy nod upon earth is fashioned the multitude of intellectual beings, and by material order a choir unto the praise of the thrice-radiant one Godhead of all, to chant a song of victory unto Thee!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Оу́тверди́ся срⷣце моѐ ѡ́ Гдⷭѣ, воз-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: оутвердися срце мое о где воз
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ κατ' ἀρχὰς τοὺς οὐρανοὺς παντοδυνάμῳ λόγῳ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: My heart is established in the Lord, my
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: My heart is established in the Lord, my horn is exalted in my God, my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies: I have rejoiced in Thy salvation!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Змї́й поползши́ из̾ Еде́ма: мене́
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: змий поползши из едема мене
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Πατρικοὺς κόλπους μὴ λιπών
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Without leaving the Father's bosom and having descended
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Without leaving the Father's bosom and having descended unto earth, O Christ God: I heard the mystery of Thy dispensation, and I glorified Thee, the only Lover of mankind!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Но́щь несвѣ́тла невѣ́рнымъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: нощ несветла неверним
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Νὺξ ἀφεγγὴς τοῖς ἀπίστοις, Χριστέ
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Night is without light unto the unbelieving, O
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Night is without light unto the unbelieving, O Christ, but unto the faithful it is illumination in the sweetness...

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Плава́ющаго в̾ дре́во жите́йскихъ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: плавающаго в древо житейских
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ναυτιλλόμενος τῷ σάλῳ τῶν βιωτικῶν μεριμνῶν
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Sailing in the surge of the billows of
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Sailing in the surge of the billows of life, and overwhelmed with the ship by sins, and cast before the soul-destroying beast, as Jonah, O Christ, I cry aloud unto Thee: Lead me up from the death-bearing depths!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Пе́щи Ѽ́троцы ѡ́гнепали́мꙋ дре́вле
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: пещи ѽтроци огнепалиму древле
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Κάμινον παῖδες πυρίνην πάλαι δροσοβόλον
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The Children of old showed the fiery furnace to be dew-bearing, praising the one God and saying: O God of our fathers, supremely exalted and supremely glorified!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Неѡпали́ма ѡ́гневи в Сина́и при-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: неопалима огневи в синаи при
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἄφλεκτος πυρὶ ἐν Σινᾷ προσομιλοῦσα βάτος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The Bush on Sinai that held communion with
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The Bush on Sinai that held communion with the fire without being burned revealed God unto Moses, who was slow of speech and stammering; and the zeal of God showed forth the three Children unburned in the fire, as chanters singing: All ye works of the Lord, bless ye the Lord, and supremely exalt Him unto the ages!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Нетлѣ́нїа неиску́сѡ ро́ждша, и все-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: нетлениа неискусо рождша и все
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Μὴ τῆς φθορᾶς διαπείρᾳ κυοφορήσασα
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Without knowing corruption Thou didst bring forth, lending
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Without knowing corruption Thou didst bring forth, lending flesh unto the all-wise Word, O Mother unwedded, Virgin Birth-giver of God, receptacle of the Uncontainable, dwelling-place of Thine uncircumscribed Creator: Thee do we magnify!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Воѡруже́нна Фараѡ́на погрузѝ: чꙋ-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: вооруженна фараона погрузи чу
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἁρματηλάτην Φαραὼ ἐβύθισε
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: He plunged the armed Pharaoh into the deep
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: He plunged the armed Pharaoh into the deep: of old the wonder-working rod of Moses, striking the sea crosswise, divided it; and it saved Israel, the fugitive traveling on foot, as he sang a song unto God!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Небесно́мꙋ кругꙋ, верхотво́рче
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: небесному кругу верхотворче
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ὁ στερεώσας κατ' ἀρχὰς τοὺς οὐρανούς
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: O Lord, Builder of the vault of heaven
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: O Lord, Builder of the vault of heaven and Founder of the Church: do Thou establish me in Thy love, O summit of desires, confirmation of the faithful, O Thou Who alone art the Lover of mankind!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ты́ ми Хрⷭте Гдⷭь, ты́же мѝ
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: ти ми хрте гд тиже ми
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Σύ μου ἰσχύς, Κύριε, σύ μου καὶ δύναμις
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Thou art my Lord, O Christ, Thou art
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Thou art my Lord, O Christ, Thou art my power, Thou art my God, Thou art my rejoicing: Who without leaving the bosom of the Father didst visit our poverty: therefore with the Prophet Habakkuk I cry aloud unto Thee: Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Вскꙋ́ю мя̀ ѿри́ну, ѿ лица̀ тво-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: вскую мя отрину от лица тво
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἵνα τί με ἀπώσω ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Why hast Thou cast me off from Thy face, O Light never-setting? And strange darkness hath covered me, the wretched one: but convert me, and unto the light of Thy commandments direct my ways, I pray Thee!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Ѡ҆чи́сти мя̀ Сп҃се, мнѡ́га бо без-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: очисти мя спсе многа бо без
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἱλάσθητί μοι, Σωτήρ, πολλαὶ γὰρ αἱ ἀνομίαι μου
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities, and lead me up from the depths of evils, I pray Thee: for unto Thee have I cried, and the God of my salvation hath heard me!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Бж҃їа схожде́нїа, ѻ҆́гнь ѹ҆сты-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: бжиа схождениа огн ѹсти
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Θεοῦ συγκατάβασιν τὸ πῦρ ᾐδέσθη ἐν Βαβυλῶνι
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The fire was ashamed before the condescension of
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The fire was ashamed before the condescension of God in Babylon of old: therefore the Children in the furnace with joyful step, as in a radiant meadow, danced, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Се́дмь седми́цею пе́щь Халде́й-
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: седм седмицею пещ халдей
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἑπταπλασίως κάμινον τῶν Χαλδαίων ὁ τύραννος
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: Sevenfold the furnace the Chaldean tyrant fiercely kindled
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: Sevenfold the furnace the Chaldean tyrant fiercely kindled for the godly: but seeing them saved by a higher power, he cried aloud unto the Creator and Deliverer: Ye children, bless; ye priests, sing praise; ye people, supreme Him unto all ages!

sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_incipit: Диви́ся ѹ҆́бѡ ѡ҆ се́мъ Нб҃о: и҆
sunday_heirmoi.slavonic_stem: дивися ѹбо о сем нбо и
sunday_heirmoi.greek: Ἐξέστη ἐπὶ τούτῳ ὁ οὐρανός
sunday_heirmoi.english_incipit: The heaven was amazed at this, and the
sunday_heirmoi.english_full: The heaven was amazed at this, and the ends of the earth were struck with wonder: that God appeared unto men in the flesh, and thy womb became more spacious than the heavens: therefore the ranks of Angels and of men magnify thee, O Theotokos!
